new_string:
How to paste from Excel

  1. In Excel, select the cells, including the heading row (Company Name, Company Number, Email…).
  2. Press Ctrl+C to copy them.
  3. Click in the box below and press Ctrl+V to paste.
  4. Press Read the cells, say which column is which, then press Import.

Text separated by commas or tabs works too. The first row must be the headings. For the practice’s master workbook, use Import in the Data section instead: it checks every row first.
